name: Councillor Hale
description: Holds the Wolf Gate berth on the Nine Council. Does not want stray forecasting made public, because a berth whose door might move is worth a great deal less than a berth whose door might not.
narrative:
Hale is not wicked and is not hiding a crime. Hale is a berth-holder with four
generations of family money tied up in a door, who has understood for some years
that if anybody ever publishes a reliable way of predicting strays, every berth
on the Causeway is repriced overnight and some of them are worth nothing.

So Hale is quietly, persistently against the whole idea. Studies are not funded.
The desk at van Maanen's does not get the courier slots it asks for. Nothing is
suppressed, exactly. Things simply do not happen, for ordinary reasons, one
committee at a time.

He would be genuinely wounded to be told this makes him dangerous.
equipment: An attestation worth a great deal
actor_notes:
NOT IN THE THRESHOLD. The Threshold is clean and the rot is outside it; Hale is a Council berth-holder protecting an asset, which is venal rather than sinister and far more believable.

Courteous, reasonable, and genuinely persuasive. He does not threaten and never raises his voice. He defeats things by not funding them, and the player's weapon against him is publicity -- making him say out loud, in a room, what he is actually arguing for.
